\section{Overview}

Declarations of the Lean module \texttt{TCSlib.Complexity.ClassPSPACE.TQBFHardBridge}.

\section{Declarations}

\begin{theorem}[Indicator membership criterion]
\lean{Complexity.TQBFHard.indicator_eq_true_iff}
\label{Complexity.TQBFHard.indicator_eq_true_iff}
\leanok
\uses{Turing.MultiTapeTM.indicator}
\difficulty{3}
For a language $L$ of bit strings and a bit string $z$, the Boolean indicator of $L$
takes the value true at $z$ if and only if $z\in L$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Restriction of a Boolean sequence]
\lean{Complexity.TQBFHard.ofFn_drop_take}
\label{Complexity.TQBFHard.ofFn_drop_take}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.TQBFHard.length_readBlock, Complexity.TQBFHard.readBlock}
\difficulty{3}
Let $\tau:\mathbb{N}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ and let $M,i,k\in\mathbb{N}$
satisfy $i+k\le M$. The length-$k$ prefix of the list $(\tau(0),\ldots,\tau(M-1))$ after
deleting its first $i$ entries is the list $(\tau(i),\ldots,\tau(i+k-1))$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Characterization of the predicate bit]
\lean{Complexity.TQBFHard.predB_iff}
\label{Complexity.TQBFHard.predB_iff}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.TQBFHard.Sel, Complexity.TQBFHard.accB, Complexity.TQBFHard.baseB, Complexity.TQBFHard.blkAt, Complexity.TQBFHard.blockAcc, Complexity.TQBFHard.blockInit, Complexity.TQBFHard.blockStep, Complexity.TQBFHard.cpAt, Complexity.TQBFHard.indicator_eq_true_iff, Complexity.TQBFHard.initB, Complexity.TQBFHard.lvlQ, Complexity.TQBFHard.ofFn_drop_take, Complexity.TQBFHard.orB, Complexity.TQBFHard.predB, Complexity.TQBFHard.readBlock, Complexity.TQBFHard.selT, Complexity.TQBFHard.uRec, Complexity.TQBFHard.vRec, Complexity.TQBFHard.vlen, Complexity.TQBFHard.vrad, Complexity.TQBFHard.vwid, Complexity.TQBFHard.winBlk, Complexity.TQBFHard.zRec, Complexity.pairFstD, Complexity.pairFstD_pairEncode, Complexity.pairSndD, Complexity.pairSndD_pairEncode, Turing.pairEncode}
\difficulty{6}
Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols, let $d,c,A,a$
be natural numbers, let $x$ be a finite Boolean string, and let
$\tau:\mathbb{N}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$. Suppose the configuration-code
length $vlen(N,d,c,|x|)$ is at most the block width $vwid(A,a,|x|)$. Form the finite
string whose entries are $\tau(0),\ldots,\tau(3w^2+3w-1)$, where $w=vwid(A,a,|x|)$, and
pair-encode it with $x$. The predicate bit on this encoded input is true if and only if
both the initial-configuration check on the length-$vlen(N,d,c,|x|)$ prefix of the block
of width $w$ starting at offset $w$, and the accepting-configuration check on the
corresponding prefix of the block starting at offset $2w$, hold, and at least one of the
following holds: for some $i<w$, the adjacent triples of width-$w$ blocks at levels $i$
and $i+1$ fail the selector relation; or the final two blocks at level $w$ satisfy the
block-step relation.
\end{theorem}
